title: Decorative Stairs and Slabs
text: Light crystals and their bricks, spiritual, infused, dream and spatial crystal blocks, shadow rock variants, mirror stone and its void-touched variants, and shadow planks have stair and slab forms.
Craft stairs and slabs at a crafting table. Stone and crystal variants can also be cut in a stonecutter.

Different materials connect under vanilla stair rules, including upside-down corners. Light is retained. Mirror stone and its variants are weightless. Single luminous crystal slabs retain half buoyancy; double slabs restore full buoyancy.
